name: file-lifecycle
description: A lifecycle for the files an agent leaves behind: a per-session scratch dir ($CLAUDE_SESSION_TMP) deleted after a grace period once the session ends, an opt-in age-based sweep of ~/.claude/tmp with a keep/ttl registry, and a long-term archive with dated names, a fail-closed secret scan, duplicate refusal and a generated INDEX.md navigator. Local-only, macOS and Linux.
